Layer.CurrentSongChangedMessageCommand:
%function(self) local ArtEle = BMIIDX14Glob.CourseArtist if ArtEle and (not BMIIDX14Glob.FirstTweening) then ArtEle:finishtweening() ArtEle:diffusealpha(0) ArtEle:addy(-12)
ArtEle:decelerate(0.2) ArtEle:diffusealpha(1) ArtEle:addy(12) end end
%function(self) if not BMIIDX14Glob.FirstTweening then self:finishtweening() end self:queuecommand('UpdateTitle') end
Layer.UpdateTitleCommand:
%function(self) local course = GAMESTATE:GetCurrentCourse() if course then if not BMIIDX14Glob.FirstTweening then self:diffusealpha(0) self:addx(-24) end
self:settext(course:GetDisplayFullTitle())
if not BMIIDX14Glob.FirstTweening then self:decelerate(0.2) self:diffusealpha(1) self:addx(24) end else self:settext('') end end

Layer.OnCommand:
%function(self) self:animate(0) self:setstate(0) self:x(SCREEN_WIDTH-98+102-18) self:y(SCREEN_CENTER_Y-220/2-self:GetHeight()/2 -15)
self:addx(30) self:sleep(0.5) self:decelerate(0.2) self:addx(-30) end

%function(self) self:animate(0) self:setstate(1) self:x(SCREEN_WIDTH-98+102-18) self:y(SCREEN_CENTER_Y -15) self:zoomtoheight(220)
self:addx(30) self:sleep(0.5) self:decelerate(0.2) self:addx(-30) end

%function(self) self:animate(0) self:setstate(2) self:x(SCREEN_WIDTH-98+102-18) self:y(SCREEN_CENTER_Y+220/2+self:GetHeight()/2 -15)
self:addx(30) self:sleep(0.5) self:decelerate(0.2) self:addx(-30) end

Layer.UpdateThumbCommand:
%function(self) local ScrollBarEle = SCREENMAN:GetTopScreen():GetChild('MusicWheel'):GetChild('') local EndDelta = 0 local T1ZoomY = ScrollBarEle:GetChildAt(1):GetZoomY() local T2ZoomY = ScrollBarEle:GetChildAt(2):GetZoomY() local T1Y = ScrollBarEle:GetChildAt(1):GetY() local T2Y = ScrollBarEle:GetChildAt(2):GetY()
if T2ZoomY >= T1ZoomY+0.01 then if T2ZoomY > 0 then EndDelta = (T1ZoomY/2)*(T1ZoomY/T2ZoomY) end self:y(SCREEN_CENTER_Y+T2Y+EndDelta -15) else if T2ZoomY > 0 then EndDelta = (T1ZoomY/2)*(T2ZoomY/T1ZoomY) end self:y(SCREEN_CENTER_Y+T1Y-EndDelta -15) end end

Layer.OnCommand:
%function(self) self:blend('add') self:diffuseramp() self:effectcolor1(1,1,1,0.3) self:effectcolor2(1,1,1,0.7)
self:addx(30) self:sleep(0.5) self:decelerate(0.2) self:addx(-30) end
